title: Investigatio motuum, quibus laminae et virgae elasticae contremiscunt

errors: None found: all four s-derivatives and both t-derivatives check out exactly, including signs (the fourth derivative returns S/f⁴).
Series coefficients on the previous page (α+β+δ, α−β+γ, α+β−δ, α−β−γ, periodic with period 4) are also correct.

ideas.what: Separation of variables / normal-mode ansatz for the transverse vibration of an elastic rod. The spatial factor is a combination of e^{±s/f}, sin(s/f), cos(s/f).
ideas.modern_name: Euler–Bernoulli beam modal solution (cosh/sinh/cos/sin mode shapes)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Daniel Bernoulli and Euler (1735–1744), Euler's Additamentum I 'De curvis elasticis' in Methodus inveniendi (E65, 1744)
ideas.where_published: E65 Additamentum I (1744); also related papers of Euler on elastic laminae; E526 revisits it

ideas.what: Listing the successive derivatives of the mode shape, to impose end conditions on y, y', y'' (moment), y''' (shear).
ideas.modern_name: Boundary conditions for beam modes (free, pinned, clamped)
ideas.where_published: E65 Additamentum; E526 continues on the following pages

ideas.what: Velocity and acceleration of a point of the rod in harmonic motion; consistency check with the PDE.
ideas.modern_name: Harmonic time dependence; verification of the separated solution

deep.surprise_reason: The page is purely routine differentiation of the known Euler–Bernoulli mode-shape solution, which Euler had published decades earlier. It is correct, with nothing new or uncredited.
transcription_corrections: 'fin.' and 'cof.' in the transcription are long-s renderings of 'sin.' and 'cos.' (ſin., coſ.). They should read sin. and cos. for consistency with the previous page.
The image reads 'virqae punctum X' (a typo in the original print for 'virgae'). The transcription silently normalizes it, which is acceptable.
